governing_rules.test_status_statement: Candidate A Test was inspected in Phase 7D (not historically virgin); Phase 6 holdout remains quarantined.

check1_usage_timestamp_semantics.semantics: In Google Borg 2011 trace, raw usage records have start_time and end_time in microseconds. Durations are strictly positive (mean: 300.0s). Grid-aligned binning maps to t = end_time_sec, ensuring all measurements in the window are fully completed and observable at or before prediction time t.

check2_peak_and_cache_measurements_causa.semantics: max_cpu_rate, max_memory, total_page_cache, unmapped_page_cache, local_disk_space, and max_disk_io_time represent aggregations over interval [t - 300s, t] and are fully observable by prediction timestamp t.

check3_raw_unit_compatibility.cpu_burstiness: max_cpu_rate (core fraction) - cpu_rate (core fraction); strictly >= 0 across 100% of dev records.
check3_raw_unit_compatibility.memory_headroom: assigned_memory (normalized memory fraction) - max_memory (normalized memory fraction); derived from identical raw reference scales before standard scaling.

check4_static_scheduler_metadata_causali.semantics: scheduling_class, priority, req_cpu, and req_ram are recorded at initial task submission (SUBMIT, event_type=0). In 100% of dev windows (3,935/3,935), submit_time <= prediction_timestamp. Attributes are invariant across the task lifecycle.

check5_dynamic_preemption_events_causali.semantics: eviction_count_prior and time_since_last_schedule are strictly evaluated on events with time_sec <= t. Zero causal timestamp violations across all 3,935 dev windows.

check6_terminal_event_leakage_audit.semantics: Zero terminal events (FAIL, FINISH, KILL) occur at or before prediction timestamp t (0/3,935 windows). Policy A excludes all post-failure telemetry. All future terminal timestamps were strictly excluded from feature inputs.
